i < dt->shared->u.array.ndims; i++) UINT32DECODE(*pp, dt->shared->u.array.dim[i]);","note":"The decoder reads one 32-bit dimension per declared axis and multiplies them into the total element count without validating that the product stays small."},{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Odtype.c","function":"H5O__dtype_decode_helper","line":587,"var":"*pp","code":"*pp += dt->shared->u.array.ndims * 4;","note":"The parser advances past the permutation bytes for the array encoding, so a large attacker-chosen rank also advances the read pointer over more file data."},{"step":9,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Odtype.c","function":"H5O__dtype_decode_helper","line":590,"var":"dt->shared->parent","code":"if (NULL == (dt->shared->parent = H5T__alloc())) ... H5O__dtype_decode_helper(ioflags, pp, dt->shared->parent)","note":"The array base type is decoded recursively from the attacker-controlled stream, so nested datatype structures can amplify the amount of metadata consumed."},{"step":10,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Odtype.c","function":"H5O__dtype_decode_helper","line":593,"var":"dt->shared->parent->shared->force_conv","code":"if (dt->shared->parent->shared->force_conv == TRUE) dt->shared->force_conv = TRUE;","note":"The decoded array type is finalized and later used by object-header consumers, so the malformed shape survives into subsequent reads."},{"step":11,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Omessage.c","function":"H5O_msg_read_oh","line":521,"var":"type->copy","code":"if (NULL == (ret_value = (type->copy)(oh->mesg[idx].native, mesg))) ...","note":"The fully decoded datatype is copied out for the caller, which is the point where the corrupted metadata can drive an out-of-bounds read in downstream consumers."}]
